identity: (1/|G|) sum_character conjugate(chi(g))*(1/|I|)sum_h_in_I chi(j F+h) = (1/|I|)1[g-jF in I]
proof: For each h, the character sum is |G| if jf+h-g=0 and 0 otherwise by finite Fourier orthogonality. Exactly one h in I may solve this, giving the stated formula.
status: independent finite character algebra sanity check, not a proof of analytic/geometric inputs or RH
